answer: Any claim can be summoned: at a random hour, the desk rings a copper bell for one filer in twenty, which must re-perform a slice of its work live within the hour. The session is hashed into the public record; the desk compares it with the filed work the same day. A no-show, or work that cannot be reproduced, voids every pending claim and bars it a week. Tending one garden of claims costs an honest worker minutes; 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 skilled operators awake at random hours. One farm drew fifty bells in a night; only three keyboards answered, the rest silent down the ridge.
